create_RDMPipeline: create an RDMPipeline instance for retrieval-augmented text-to-image generation with CLIP and UNet
run_RDMPipeline_generate: run the RDMPipeline to generate images from text prompts with optional retrieved reference images
encode_RDMPipeline_prompt: encode text prompts into normalized CLIP text embeddings using the RDMPipeline tokenizer and CLIP model
encode_RDMPipeline_image: encode retrieved reference images into normalized CLIP image embeddings for retrieval-augmented diffusion
retrieve_RDMPipeline_images: retrieve similar images from a retriever based on prompt embeddings and append them to the retrieval list
